blurb: Come visit one of the great secrets of the southeast. Lake Burton was impounded in 1920 and is surrounded by some of the most beautiful mountains in the world. It has 62 miles of shoreline and is 2775 acres large. There is even an old town (the town of Burton) under the lake! Anchorage Boat Dock was built by Ned and Ruth Stockton in 1959.
